Eli (Partnerships): Quick: for CloudShelf marketplace launch we need a single concierge channel and a short SEV path. Proposal: #cloudshelf-concierge, p0/p1 tags, 10m ack, and daily 15m checks for 48h. Thoughts?

Rhea (Partner Eng): +1. Keep tripod flow: partner -> partner-eng -> marketplace -> SRE (only with escalate:sre). Pin a 6-step checklist.

Owen (Marketplace): Channel name fine. Recommend auto-tagging and a short message template partners must use (env, impact, steps).

Sam (SRE): SRE only pages on p0 where infra metrics show partner error spike or `escalate:sre`. Ack SLA p0=5m, p1=15m. Also require incident stub in #incidents for p0.

Tess (CS): I'll add SI/vendor slack handles and a "how to report" message. Also prefer rotation: Rhea (day), Owen (eve), Tess (overnight).

Rhea (Partner Eng): Draft checklist to pin:
1) Tag: p0/p1/nonsev + env
2) Short impact, steps, logs
3) Assign owner @PartnerEng
4) Add escalate:sre if infra
5) Include partner contact
6) Postmortem owner within 3 business days

PartnerOpsBot: Will create channel, auto-ack, apply tags by keyword, and create incident stubs for p0. Template: https://templates.redwood.com/concierge

Eli (Partnerships): OK I'll create the channel and set rotations. We'll run a 10m pre-launch SRE walkthru. Keep it lightweight and we'll iterate after 48h. :rocket:
